approval_ordering: Gate1(unvalidated) -> yield -> validation -> Gate2 -> execution (global, test-pinned)
authority_boundary: workspace/tools/depth/budgets host; text/role/timeout-proposal model; auto_approve/auto_retry keys model-influenceable (gap)
context_amplification: N x (base+role+tools+env) per worker; fresh history/memory/map; return capped 8k/2k/240 chars
model_none: schema rejects explicit null; executor+child-config inherit (mismatch proven)
recursion_bound: depth enforced (default 2); branching unenforced on live paths
result_integrity: no truncation-to-success; no cancelled-as-success; evidence loss via digests
retry_formula: logical 1+min(max_retries,5) shared-budget; physical ~stream3xhttp3xiters unbudgeted; tie-breaker/reducer/graph-stacking unbudgeted
timeout_ownership: turn 1800s; child role/contract timeouts; fanout-path unclamped; orphans possible+logged
trigger: surface + task-shape (I0-I2); runtime does not solicit
